requestBody.query: SIM card locked on my phone

200.answer: If your SIM card is locked, you will need to reset your PIN by entering your SIM card's unique unlock key. You can retrieve your unlock key by logging in to MyBell. Note that entering an incorrect unlock key 10 times will permanently lock your SIM card.

snippets.text: Mobility Overview Using my device Rate plans and features Prepaid Network, coverage and travel Self-serve options Troubleshooting tools and help Your current region: Ontario Change Select your province or territory below: Alberta British Columbia Manitoba New Brunswick Newfoundland And Labrador Northwest Territories Nova Scotia Nunavut Ontario Prince Edward Island Quebec Saskatchewan Yukon Close province setting I get an error message on my phone that says "SIM card locked" The SIM card on your mobile phone will become locked if you enter an incorrect personal identification number (PIN) three times. You won't be able to use your phone, except for emergency calls. To unlock it you must reset your PIN by entering your SIM card's unique unlock key (also called a PIN unblocking key or PUK). To unlock your SIM card: Log in to MyBell and retrieve your unlock key. Enter the unlock key on your mobile phone. Note: Entering an incorrect unlock key 10 times will permanently lock your SIM card.

agentUtterance.text: If you get an error message on your phone that says "SIM card locked", it means you entered an incorrect personal identification number (PIN) three times. To unlock it, you'll need to reset your PIN by entering your SIM card's unique unlock key. You can retrieve your unlock key by logging in to MyBell. Note that entering an incorrect unlock key 10 times will permanently lock your SIM card. Did that resolve your issue, or is there anything else I can help you with today?
